descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Time has left its traces inside this hotel. Pick up a mysterious lens, examine forgotten objects, and uncover the story hidden behind locked doors.

Zaman Oteli - Time Hotel is a single-player VR puzzle adventure built around hands-on exploration. Turn mechanisms, connect clues and use the lens to reveal details concealed in the present. Vahan, the hotel’s clockmaker, narrates each step deeper into Leyla’s story.

SEVEN CONNECTED CHAPTERS
Begin in Room 307, continue through the Music Salon and Clock Tower, descend from the Attic Archive through the Boiler Room to the Deep Foundation, and end with The Last Chord.

FOUR SEASONS
The base game has 7 chapters. Expansions: Frozen Carriages (1934, the Istanbul–Paris train, 6 chapters), Lost & Found (7 chapters with an hourglass) and the new The Source of Time (7 chapters in the cistern beneath the hotel, with an oil lamp that reveals erased writing). The first chapters of Lost & Found and The Source of Time are free with the base game.

EXPLORE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Look closely, experiment with objects and ring the hint bell when you need a nudge, or play The Source of Time in Detective mode, without hints. Saved progress lets you return to the mystery.

ENGLISH AND TURKISH
Voiced narration and subtitles in both languages; switch from the game’s menu. Played with VR motion controllers.
